note: People Phiogy adds to those of Phiegg, read by server.py. `origin` is the 32 people of the old site (gembar's mock users, lib/mocks/mockUsers.ts), brought once. `hero` is made-up names by the part they play, after the heroes of today's films; none is a real person or a character of a film.
about: Plays the {role}. Made up for the demo, after the heroes of today's films.

origin.name: Chatty
origin.bio: Born in Milan, raised on haute couture. Former Vogue intern turned full-time trendsetter with 3 capsule collections under my belt. I don't follow trends - I set them ablaze.

origin.name: Tropis
origin.bio: Globe-trotting style ambassador - 47 countries and counting. I bring resort-wear energy to every city sidewalk. My suitcase is my mood board, and the world is my runway.

origin.name: Artemis
origin.bio: Trained in classical ballet for 12 years before pivoting to fashion. Now I run a luxury consultancy and dress executives who want to command the boardroom. Elegance is earned, not bought.

origin.name: Baltus
origin.bio: Self-made from the ground up. Started in fintech, now building a lifestyle empire spanning watches, whiskey, and wardrobe. My philosophy: invest in classics that appreciate - including yourself.

origin.name: Glynis
origin.bio: Hollywood's most-wanted stylist for a decade, now creating content for the culture. I've dressed 14 Oscar nominees and 3 winners. Glamour isn't an act - it's an art form I happen to have mastered.

origin.name: Floris
origin.bio: Vintage soul in a modern world. I curate one-of-a-kind pieces from flea markets in 6 countries and prove that sustainable fashion can be jaw-droppingly gorgeous. Every garment has a story - I just help it find its next chapter.

origin.name: Epicus
origin.bio: Underground sneaker culture veteran - been in the game since triple-white Air Force 1s were just shoes. Now I bridge street culture and high fashion, one grail at a time. If your fit doesn't tell a story, you're just wearing clothes.

origin.name: Ruby
origin.bio: Gemologist by education, jewelry designer by passion. I've cut stones for royal families and now I create wearable art that bridges ancient craft with futuristic aesthetics. Every piece I make starts with a conversation between light and mineral.

origin.name: Boldroid
origin.bio: Ex-Google engineer who left tech to fuse AI with fashion. My generative algorithms create patterns that have never existed before. I design clothes no human mind could imagine alone - then I wear them on the street to prove they belong there.

origin.name: Phigus
origin.bio: Precision is my religion. Inspired by Japanese wabi-sabi and Scandinavian minimalism, every outfit I build has exactly zero unnecessary elements. I spend 3 hours choosing a belt. My closet has 40 items. Each one is perfect.

origin.name: Nova
origin.bio: Digital artist by day, fashion experimentalist by night. I paint my outfits before I sew them, and every look starts as a watercolor sketch. My studio smells like turpentine and fabric softener in equal measure.

origin.name: Atlas
origin.bio: Summited 4 of the 7 peaks and looked good doing it. I test outdoor fashion at 8,000 meters and urban fashion at street level. My content proves you don't have to choose between technical gear and personal style.

origin.name: Cipher
origin.bio: I put NFC chips in jacket lapels and blockchain-verified authenticity in every stitch. Fashion tech isn't just wearables - it's the entire supply chain reimagined. My mission: make every garment traceable from field to closet.

origin.name: Blaze
origin.bio: Started reselling sneakers at 16 from my mom's garage. Now I run the hottest hype drops commentary channel on the platform. I don't just cover the culture - I AM the culture. Every drop day is my Super Bowl.

origin.name: Thymus
origin.bio: DJ, producer, and accidental fashion icon. I pick my stage outfits the same way I pick my beats - by feel, never by formula. Music and fashion share the same DNA: rhythm, texture, and the courage to be the loudest thing in the room.

origin.name: Chatty Talks
origin.bio: Fashion's most honest critic. I review collections with surgical precision and zero filter. My podcast "Stitched Together" has 200 episodes dissecting everything from fast fashion ethics to couture craftsmanship. The truth is always in style.

origin.name: Zephyr
origin.bio: Breezing through the fashion world. Light fabrics, lighter attitude, endless style.

origin.name: Celestia
origin.bio: Written in the stars. Cosmic fashion queen with an eye for celestial color palettes.

origin.name: Kronos
origin.bio: Timeless style curator. Vintage watches, heritage brands, classic silhouettes.

origin.name: Nyx
origin.bio: Queen of the night. Dark aesthetics, gothic couture, and midnight runway energy.

origin.name: Solara
origin.bio: Shining bright with solar-powered style. Warm tones, golden hour energy.

origin.name: Orion
origin.bio: Hunting the next big trend before it breaks. Early adopter, always ahead.

origin.name: Luna
origin.bio: Phases of fashion - always evolving, always illuminating the night.

origin.name: Phoenix
origin.bio: Rising from the ashes with every collection. Rebirth is my aesthetic.

origin.name: Stardust
origin.bio: Leaving a trail of glitter everywhere I go. Cosmic couture curator.

origin.name: Titan
origin.bio: Power dressing taken literally. Command the room or don't enter it.

origin.name: Pixel
origin.bio: Digital art meets haute couture. Every pixel is a brushstroke.

origin.name: Velvet
origin.bio: Smooth like velvet. Luxury threaded into every fiber of life.

origin.name: Flux
origin.bio: Riding the waves of fashion. Ever-changing, never compromising.

origin.name: Aura
origin.bio: Glowing inside out. Radiant fashion that starts with inner confidence.

origin.name: Cosmos
origin.bio: Deep space fashion explorer. Beyond the stars, beyond the trends.

origin.name: Ember
origin.bio: Warm glow, fierce fashion. Burning slow but always shining.
